cases.title: Separated roles in overlapping replay
cases.steps: Replay self and remote with overlapping times.
cases.assertion: Both roles/times retained; no mixing; remote does not advance reader.

cases.title: Real loopback routing
cases.steps: Play known output fixture and capture selected endpoint.
cases.assertion: Real WASAPI buffers, expected route/duration/correlation; host recorded.

cases.title: No hidden generation calls
cases.steps: Run manual session including silence, new question and correction; then Send.
cases.assertion: 0 generative requests before Send and exactly 1 normal answer request after; STT counted separately.

cases.title: Partial upsert
cases.steps: Deliver multiple revisions of one segment.
cases.assertion: Single evolving segment and one final persisted result.

cases.title: Reconnect time mapping
cases.steps: Reset provider timestamp on new connection and deliver duplicates.
cases.assertion: No global timeline reset or duplicate committed text.

cases.title: Multi-part question snapshot
cases.steps: Select question with several remote segments and self context, click Send.
cases.assertion: Real backend payload includes chosen segment revisions and relevant self context.

cases.title: ASR watermark lag
cases.steps: Click Send while captured audio leads transcription.
cases.assertion: Tail handled by documented wait/provisional policy; no silent omission.

cases.title: Cancel old stream
cases.steps: Cancel A; start B; release late A deltas.
cases.assertion: Only B updates active answer; A remains interrupted if stored.

cases.title: Unread revision
cases.steps: Read paragraph 1, request rewrite and stream new suffix.
cases.assertion: Read prefix frozen; new version/source mapping valid.

cases.title: Self lexical following
cases.steps: Replay near-verbatim self speech while remote also speaks.
cases.assertion: Cursor follows self only; LLM request count unchanged.

cases.title: Skip/repeat/number/acronym
cases.steps: Run Indonesian/English repeated phrases, numeric variants and skips.
cases.assertion: Bounded moves to correct anchors; no global common-word jump.

cases.title: Off-script and interim retraction
cases.steps: Leave script, revise interim hypothesis, then rejoin.
cases.assertion: Tentative progress retracts safely; viewport freezes/reacquires.

cases.title: Known-source import
cases.steps: Parse actual controlled PDF/Office fixtures.
cases.assertion: Expected text/page/section extracted, failures flagged, no mocked parser-only pass.

cases.title: Cross-language and scale retrieval
cases.steps: Search known ID/English/Indonesian facts among distractors.
cases.assertion: Correct evidence/neighbor context found within budget; synthetic scale labeled.

cases.title: Workspace isolation
cases.steps: Switch between two workspaces with conflicting facts.
cases.assertion: Prompt and memory contain only selected workspace/profile sources.

cases.title: Suggestion contamination
cases.steps: Generate false experience claim, then replay user reading it.
cases.assertion: Unverified claim not promoted to confirmed profile.

cases.title: Correction and rollback
cases.steps: Apply explicit correction, consolidate, supersede and rollback.
cases.assertion: New fact scoped/provenanced; old version recoverable.

cases.title: Compaction
cases.steps: Exceed active budget with pinned fact/question/correction.
cases.assertion: Active items/source IDs preserved; originals retained.

cases.title: Browser reading UI
cases.steps: Run keyboard and long-text flows at UI sizes.
cases.assertion: Readable layout, no overflow/unstable paragraph, reduced-motion behavior.

cases.title: Native focus/scaling
cases.steps: Use hotkey while another window focused; inspect actual Windows scales.
cases.assertion: No unintended focus stealing; controls usable at recorded scales.

cases.title: Model interchange
cases.steps: Select two configured model routes and a smaller context limit.
cases.assertion: Actual route/model recorded, context repacked; fixture-only parts distinctly labeled.

cases.title: Restart recovery
cases.steps: Persist session, stop owned app, relaunch isolated profile.
cases.assertion: Final segments/settings recover; no duplicate provider request.

cases.title: Native real backend flow
cases.steps: Launch built Tauri binary with boundary fixture servers.
cases.assertion: Real IPC/storage/context executes; visible streaming response matches captured backend payload.

cases.title: Physical mic
cases.steps: Capture actual selected microphone signal.
cases.assertion: Actual buffers/device identity recorded; absent controlled speech remains unverified.

cases.title: Device recovery
cases.steps: Exercise available real endpoint change/disconnect.
cases.assertion: Observed transition/gap/recovery; simulation separately labeled.

cases.title: Capture compatibility
cases.steps: Capture calibration pattern through named API/meeting mode.
cases.assertion: Observed exclusion result with app/OS versions; no universal claim.

cases.title: Live STT
cases.steps: Send controlled ID/EN/mixed WAV within caps.
cases.assertion: Actual provider transcript, word/entity errors and stream semantics measured.

cases.title: Live grounded LLM
cases.steps: Send fixture context through selected model.
cases.assertion: Actual text streaming, source correctness, cancellation and usage evidenced.

cases.title: Real-time soak
cases.steps: Run 30–60 minutes with controlled streams and metrics.
cases.assertion: Wall-clock duration, queue/resource growth/dropouts/recovery recorded.

cases.title: Production isolation
cases.steps: Probe release for test control and inspect secret/log/export boundaries.
cases.assertion: Privileged test hooks absent/rejected; no secret disclosure; appropriate negative assertions.

cases.title: Installer/update lifecycle
cases.steps: Install, launch, persist settings, exercise test update-policy, uninstall isolated profile.
cases.assertion: Artifact hashes/revision known; lifecycle matches data policy; signing status accurate.

cases.title: Final rehearsal and review
cases.steps: Independent review and final gate aggregation on integrated revision.
cases.assertion: No unresolved critical findings; required fail/blocked/not_run prevent release-verified label.
